description: This file provides utility functions for string formatting within a web application's UI layer. It offers functions to convert strings to camelCase and Title Case, handling various delimiters and special characters to ensure consistent string normalization across components.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase by normalizing delimiters (spaces, underscores, hyphens), collapsing multiple spaces, and concatenating words with appropriate casing.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display by normalizing delimiters, collapsing spaces, lowercasing, then capitalizing the first letter of each word and after apostrophes, while preserving special characters and accents.
